translationRepairs: Yet Weihan was bold in action. Surveying strategic points, he converted the Lzhou Guard thousand-household post into Qingxi County.
Yet Weihan was bold in action. Surveying strategic points, he converted the Lizhou Guard thousand-household post into Qingxi County.
Chinese 黎州 is Lizhou; Lzhou drops the medial vowel and corrupts the place name. The proposed idiomatic keeps the rest of the accurate wording and only restores Lizhou.
Yet Weihan was bold in undertaking affairs; surveying key points, he changed the Lzhou Guard thousand-household post and established Qingxi County.
Yet Weihan was bold in undertaking affairs; surveying key points, he changed the Lizhou Guard thousand-household post and established Qingxi County.
Chinese 黎州 is Lizhou; Lzhou is a corrupted romanization. The proposed literal corrects only that place name while preserving the accurate establishment wording.
Censor Wu Tao had falsified land surveys in eastern Sichuan, and Weihan was sent to assist the investigation.
Censor Wu Tao had surveyed land falsely in eastern Sichuan, and Weihan was sent to assist him.

以維翰助之 means Weihan was assigned to assist Wu Tao (之), not to assist a separate investigation; 丈田不實 is surveying land inaccurately. The proposed idiomatic restores both points, and s0131’s replacement follows from assisting him first.
